# Synthetic fixtures only

Every fixture in this directory must be invented specifically for Mnemosyne tests.

- Never copy and anonymise a real memory, note, attachment, path, or configuration file.
- Use fictional people, facts, identifiers, and placeholder paths.
- Label a fixture as synthetic in its content when the future schema supports that field.
- Keep real vault data outside the Git worktree, including during local testing.

Memory fixtures will be added only after the canonical Markdown schema is defined.
